content.value_statement: Developer slide decks often need code, diagrams, notes, and exports in one workflow. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through Slidev syntax and presentation features.
actual_capabilities: Creates Slidev decks with Markdown slide separators, frontmatter, and presenter notes.
Adds code highlighting, line numbers, magic move animations, and Monaco editor examples.
Configures diagrams with Mermaid, PlantUML, and LaTeX math examples.
Uses built-in layouts, slots, draggable elements, themes, and scoped styling.
Explains presenter mode, timers, recording, remote control, and export settings.
Guides PDF, PPTX, PNG, SPA build, SEO metadata, and remote asset setup.
limitations: It depends on Slidev and project dependencies being installed by the user or agent.
Exports may require Playwright Chromium and a working browser environment.
Remote assets, if used, depend on external URLs remaining available.
It provides guidance, not a hosted presentation service or design review system.

use_cases.title: Prepare Conference Talks
use_cases.description: Create a polished technical talk with code examples, speaker notes, animations, and export-ready slides.

use_cases.title: Teach Engineering Workshops
use_cases.description: Build lessons with stepwise code reveals, diagrams, runnable examples, and presenter notes for live instruction.

use_cases.title: Document Product Architecture
use_cases.description: Turn architecture notes into visual slides with diagrams, layouts, embedded examples, and shareable static output.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Deck
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner prompt for a new Slidev presentation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a five-slide Slidev deck about TypeScript generics with speaker notes, code examples, and click-to-reveal explanations.

prompt_templates.title: Improve Existing Slides
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate prompt for enhancing a draft deck.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Slidev deck and add better layouts, speaker notes, code highlighting, and one Mermaid diagram where useful.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare for Export
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prompt for publishing and handouts.
prompt_templates.prompt: Configure this Slidev project for PDF export, SPA hosting, SEO metadata, and a downloadable presentation file.

prompt_templates.title: Build an Interactive Workshop
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prompt for live teaching material.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a Slidev workshop deck with runnable Monaco examples, staged code animations, timers, presenter notes, and export instructions.

output_examples.input: A request for a TypeScript talk deck.
output_examples.output: A Slidev deck outline with title, agenda, code-focused slides, speaker notes, and click animation guidance.

output_examples.input: A draft deck that needs better structure.
output_examples.output: A revised slide plan using two-column layouts, diagrams, presenter notes, and export-ready configuration.

output_examples.input: A request to publish slides after a talk.
output_examples.output: Deployment guidance with build settings, social preview metadata, downloadable PDF options, and export checks.

best_practices: Keep code examples short enough to read from the back of a room.
Use presenter notes for delivery details instead of crowding the slide canvas.
Verify export output before sharing slides or publishing a hosted deck.
anti_patterns: Do not place long source files directly on slides without highlighting.
Do not rely on remote assets when the talk must work offline.
Do not enable interactive features without testing them in presentation mode.

faq.question: Does this skill create Slidev projects from scratch?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide project creation, slide structure, syntax, features, and verification steps.

faq.question: Can it help with existing Slidev decks?
faq.answer: Yes. It can improve layout, frontmatter, code blocks, notes, diagrams, and export settings.

faq.question: Does it require Vue knowledge?
faq.answer: Basic Markdown is enough for simple decks. Vue knowledge helps when adding custom components.

faq.question: Can it export presentations?
faq.answer: It explains Slidev export workflows. Some export formats require Playwright Chromium and local dependencies.

faq.question: Does it support diagrams and math?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for Mermaid, PlantUML, and LaTeX math inside Slidev slides.

faq.question: Is recording automatic?
faq.answer: No. Recording is a Slidev presenter feature that users start from the presentation interface.
